title: stelis thymochila
intro: Stelis thymochila, commonly known as the False Thorn, is a plant species in the orchid family that is native to the tropical regions of Central America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Stelis thymochila include its ability to act as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic, making it useful in wound care and skin issues. The bioactive constituents of Stelis thymochila include flavonoids and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
